mood: Vertical coral poster: a huge blue muzzle opens coral lips around teeth, red tongue and black depth; coarse white cheek joins a narrow white neck and blue-white knit. Apart, hooked black horns, drooping ears, blue brow, ragged coral tuft and a red eye form the second large mass. Dense blue rectilinear maze bands cross bare coral; smaller colored seams, wet recesses and drawn interruptions inhabit those bands.
material_language: Coarse white fur with shallow photographic relief beside blue-and-white ribbed knit.
Scuffed black horn and ear surfaces beside smooth coral lips and a glossy red tongue.
Flat vivid coral and electric-blue grid; local grain and contour drawing.
Small wet recesses interrupt patterned surfaces without becoming separate sculptural objects.
lighting: Shallow frontal illumination preserves fur relief and faint horn highlights; deep mouth blacks and sharp graphic color dominate, not sculptural shading.
object_inventory: A coral-lipped blue muzzle with white teeth and a red tongue in black depth.
A red peaked seam over pale pink scallops within an electric-blue band.
A grainy green-blue channel with a pale cloud-shaped edge through a blue band.
A small water-dark recess with colored marine forms and a crumpled blue rim.
A pink-orange swelling edged by unequal shallow notches in a pale band.
A long mauve crease ends in yellow beside a pale, delicately outlined edge.
A stepped blue bridge carries a flared blue stroke across a yellow gap.
A white cleft cuts a multicolored band ledge bearing broken seated contours.
negative_constraints: No complete frontal head, near-copy arrangement, pasted source imagery or framed artwork.
No landscape, room, skyline, restaurant scene, cemetery setting or independent marine world.
No shell sculptures, reef ornaments, gold curls or generalized fleshy folds replacing recognizable anatomy.
No sparse freehand tracery replacing the dense rectilinear maze; no omission of the narrow white neck.
No labels, legible text, logos, cards, interface chrome, pins, target rings or debug marks.
No fabricated source attribution, inferred animation, identifiable portrait copies or uniform volumetric rendering.
